objective: Read the Simple Note and speak to Harutt Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.

description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, <name>. I believe she was sent by the warrior trainer Harutt. If this note is from Harutt, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
progress: Ah, at last, you've arrived, warrior. I did not lie in my note, <name>. We are a special breed also, not unlike the druids or shamans of our tribe. You are just as important. We are the ones called upon to defend our borders, to hunt the centaur, and to go to war.
completion: Each of us plays a role in our tribe. Each of us must also go through all the same rites. Do not ever let your pride tell you otherwise.

I remain here to train new warriors that seek the glory of battle and who follow the ways of our oldest ancestors. When you feel ready, come back to me and I will do what I can to train you further. Go with the tribe's blessing, <name>.
